override._why: The profile Name keyboard (from about 25 s, cursor on 1) has ENTER four rows down; A only types and Start does nothing. Down x4, A; then New Profile opens on NAME (A reopens the keyboard): down x2 to CREATE PROFILE, A; then Options opens on CONTROLLER: down x4 to CONTINUE, A. The defaults then pick Campaign.
